This retains the original toward-zero change convention; it is not floor of a negative number and not floor of absolute target shares. Fill can only reduce/reject requested buys.

sizing_and_unwind.exit: At15:59 sell precisely remaining delta_q, charged actual own fees/slippage/monthly tiers. Do not rebalance to baseline weights, buy back baseline shares, or top up cash. No after-close/auction fill approximation.
sizing_and_unwind.conservation: Absent a separately approved intervening risk reduction, after exit q_after==q_before exactly and receivables unchanged; cash retains actual round-trip PnL and costs. Subsequent Stage1 uses this own actual wealth/history/fee state.
sizing_and_unwind.no_extra_intraday_stop: v1 adds no discretionary interval stop or dynamic exit threshold. Unsupported missed/partial exit is retained as an execution failure with surviving inventory; do not fabricate flatness or omit that day.
sizing_and_unwind.postfee_envelope: Every actual admitted fill, including cases with a negative sub-share delta and no physical sale, must satisfy beta<=effective_late_cap, SOXL<=.30, cash-like>=.15, risky mass<=frozen raw_soxl_weight+raw_soxx_weight, nonnegative q/spendable_cash and unwind-fee reserve. Truncate/reject only; no baseline sale and no cap/risky-mass waiver.
